title: Vulco — modular DC charger, 60–480 kW | Anari Energy
meta: Vulco: Opens at 60–120 kW and scales to 480 kW by adding modules. The choice for operators who expect the site to grow and do not want to replace the cabinet

sections.lede: Opens at 60–120 kW and scales to 480 kW by adding modules. The choice for operators who expect the site to grow and do not want to replace the cabinet to get there.
sections.note: Specifications below are the published configuration; the binding constraint on your site decides the variant.

rows.v: CE · TÜV · 48-hour salt spray · semi-potted electronics
Reserved heater interface for sub-zero regions

sections.lede: Sites expected to expand: start small on the grid you have, add modules when utilisation justifies the connection upgrade. It runs at 96% peak efficiency, and upgrading 120 → 480 kW costs about 70% less than replacing the whole cabinet.

items.title: Typical deployment
items.text: Chosen when the site constraint matches the family, not because it is the cheapest unit.

items.title: What decides the variant
items.text: Grid capacity, duty cycle, climate envelope and connector standard.

items.title: What to send us
items.text: Available kVA, vehicles served per day, dwell time and ambient temperature range.

items.title: How it is delivered
items.text: Within the turnkey scope: design, permits, installation supervision, commissioning and handover.

sections.h2: Send the site parameters and we will return a Vulco configuration.
sections.lede: Available capacity, duty cycle and climate are enough to narrow the variant in one exchange.
